title: Torbin
description: The son of paupers from the planet Bonadan, Master Torbin was a mere Padawan when he went to Brendok as part of a team to investigate a vergence in the Force. After what he witnessed there, he tried everything he could to forget. Stationed at a Jedi outpost on Olega, he took a Barash Vow and remained in silent meditation for years until Mae Aniseya offered him a chance for absolution.
